summary: Frontend-only regression for AI Video Edit discoverability fix. Verified BOTH edit entry points (top-right overlay pill 'video-edit-overlay-{id}' and prominent full-width iris bar 'video-edit-{id}') are visible on every DONE video card, are prominently styled with bg-lumiere-iris, and each opens the VideoEditor modal with all controls. Regression confirmed: selecting 9:16 + warm filter + editor-export creates a new kind='edit' job (verified in DB with edited_path set, status=DONE). Delete button still present. Screenshot shows both edit buttons highly visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The bottom edit bar visually splits from the card since it's rendered outside the rounded card wrapper's inner section; acceptable given the prominent CTA intent, but could be tucked inside the rounded container for cleaner corners.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded video_jobs id='admin-demo-vid'. Test also created a real edit job id=65f46a22-... which persists in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both edit entry points verified with data-testid selectors: video-edit-overlay-{id} (top-right pill) and video-edit-{id} (bottom iris bar with text 'Editar Pro · Formato, filtros y logo' / 'Pro Edit · Format, filters & logo'). Editor export end-to-end also confirmed working (POST /api/video/jobs/{id}/edit returns DONE edit job).
rca of the issue: Original discoverability bug root cause: the previous Edit CTA was a thin low-contrast bar with border-only styling, blending into the ivory card background. Fix applied: (1) added an always-visible floating pill overlay on top-right of the DONE video thumbnail (backdrop-blurred iris bg), (2) replaced the subtle bar with a full-width solid bg-lumiere-iris text-white bar with descriptive text and glow shadow. Bar bounding box height=40px, both use bg-lumiere-iris → high contrast against ivory page bg.
